verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Shortwave connects to MCP servers and third-party apps, but there is no mention of issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials/tokens for an agent; if anything, one commenter raises concern about apps requesting too many broad Gmail permissions, with no counter-evidence of scoped credential controls. Missing for 10: any documentation of API key/token scoping, permission granularity settings, or credential management for agents.
